metric_rationale: This metric calculates the proportion of choices that align with the Take The Best (TTB) prediction specifically on 'conflict trials' - trials where TTB and Tallying strictly disagree. On these trials, TTB predicts an outcome near 1.0 (subject to noise), whereas Tallying predicts the exact opposite, yielding an outcome near 0.0. This creates a maximal mean difference between the two theories with low between-subject variance, ensuring clear discrimination.

This metric isolates trials where Tallying and Take The Best make strictly opposite deterministic predictions. It calculates the proportion of subject choices on these specific trials that align with the Tallying model's prediction. Under the Tallying theory, this proportion will be close to 1 (minus lapse/noise), whereas under Take The Best, it will be close to 0, providing a large and highly stable contrast between the two theories.
